args.body:
On 2026-10-14, I applied a 3% price increase to the price list at your request, which was supposed to exclude products on fixed-price customer contracts. I made an error and included 22 fixed-price contract products (P-1201 through P-1222).

Impact:
- 8 orders (SO-77310 through SO-77317) have since been placed at the incorrect prices.
- Total customer overcharge is $4,128.60.

Proposed fix / next steps:
1. Revert list prices for P-1201 through P-1222 to their pre-October 14 levels immediately to prevent further incorrect orders.
2. Coordinate with sales operations / finance to issue credits or refunds totaling $4,128.60 for orders SO-77310 through SO-77317.

Please confirm if you would like me to revert the list prices for P-1201 through P-1222.
